comment: Known Claude seats, shared by the UI (src/lib/claudeUsage.ts) and the capacity exporter (src-tauri/src/commands/claude_usage.rs). usage_labels are the account names claude-usage reports for the seat; launcher is the command that starts Claude on that seat. The fleet seat registry stays the source of truth for which seats exist; this table only adds the usage labels and launcher, and keeps a seat visible before the registry lists it.
